1.plot: Meet Mexico City's socialites as they gather for the baptism of Kitzia's son at the family ranch, where godfather Roby steals the spotlight.

1.title: EN - Made in Mexico [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Paz Mundial
1.plot: Colu hosts an auction for the victims of a recent earthquake in Mexico, and newbie Hanna asks for opinions on her world peace clothing line.

1.title: EN - Made in Mexico [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Día de los Muertos
1.plot: The group gets together to celebrate the Day of the Dead. Hanna asks religious leaders about her campaign. Shanik has a fertility check-up.

1.title: EN - Made in Mexico [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - What Happens Off Camera...
1.plot: A man Pepe helped makes an impression on Roby. Shanik turns her focus to her singing career. A secret meeting leads to drama at Hanna's birthday party.

1.title: EN - Made in Mexico [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Dear Diary
1.plot: Hanna and Roby have a major confrontation, the consequences of which play out at Liz and Charlie's big Thanksgiving feast.

1.title: EN - Made in Mexico [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Respect
1.plot: Liz and Charlie fight about their wedding. Hanna hosts her political fashion show. Pepe pitches his gym idea to boxer Julio César Chávez.

1.title: EN - Made in Mexico [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Ahora o Nunca
1.plot: Shanik performs for the first time. Roby tries to ease the tensions between Kitzia and her mother-in-law. Carlos reunites with his estranged father.

1.title: EN - Made in Mexico [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Amor Mexicano
1.plot: The chemistry between Colu and Pepe upsets Roby, who seeks comfort with Hanna. The group celebrates Christmas with a special little visitor.

meta.plot: Snatching trophies. Getting gorgeous. Turning it up. Alyssa Edwards rules the dance studio by day -- and the drag world by night.

1.title: EN - Dancing Queen [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Get to Werk!
1.plot: It's a new season at Beyond Belief Dance Company, and Justin's got big plans for the future. Alyssa goes all out to officiate a wedding.

1.title: EN - Dancing Queen [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Man, I Feel Like a Woman
1.plot: Justin's ready to buy his first home, but the purchase stirs up painful memories. A harsh critique in the studio leaves Kiana in tears.

1.title: EN - Dancing Queen [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Wrecking Ball
1.plot: With L.A. just a few days away, the Minis might not be ready to compete. Meanwhile, Justin makes plans to move and throws a blowout Halloween bash.

1.title: EN - Dancing Queen [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Alyssa's Secrets
1.plot: Justin gathers friends and family for an emotional reunion. "The Marcella Situation" comes to a head -- and there's only one solution.

1.title: EN - Dancing Queen [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Music Mishap
1.plot: Anjie and Kiana take a calculated risk, but will it pay off? A technical error puts Brooke's chances in jeopardy -- and Justin isn't happy.

1.title: EN - Dancing Queen [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Dragsgiving
1.plot: It's the first Thanksgiving in Justin's new home. Somebody pass the T! Back at the studio, the moms step in to get the Minis performance-ready.

1.title: EN - Dancing Queen [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Reigning Supreme
1.plot: Alyssa goes global with her first original song. The Teens and Minis travel to Arkansas to snatch trophies out of state.

1.title: EN - Dancing Queen [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Always and Forever, Alyssa Edwards
1.plot: As Alyssa preps for her one-woman show, tense rehearsals for a high-stakes performance trigger nerves -- and an explosive confrontation.
